purpose: Real saved-Cosha native Dress diagnostic with synthetic representative inputs

thresholds.origin: Replay guard retained from prior real-X checks; other limits are explicit QA diagnostics

limits: Saved file only; no live unsaved scene is inspected
Synthetic inputs are not production walks, turns, squats or foot planting
Vertex signed distance does not prove absence of triangle intersections
Closed generated collision proxies are not the actual body mesh
60-frame default is a short diagnostic, not long-run equilibrium
Blender Cloth and Unity Magica Cloth require separate effect validation
No render or production animation acceptance is performed

registered_body_diagnostic_summary.coverage: Unsigned/normal distance only or skipped; actual body penetration is unproved

stop_settling.observation: Last ten frames only; this short interval is not long-run equilibrium

initial_saved_owned_cache.policy: Refuse any pre-existing sealed, disk, external or baking cache; no artist cache files are enumerated or touched
initial_saved_owned_cache.reason: No saved owned Dress physics cache

input_definition.height_definition: Body deform Rest head/tail Z extent excluding owned Dress, multiplied by rig world Z scale
input_definition.leg_bend_axis: MainRig Rest +X converted to each native bone local space

motion_formulas.walk: +Y .28*height, two sine cycles, +/-18 degree thighs and up to -20 degree shin swing
motion_formulas.turn: 100 degree smooth local-Z yaw plus .08*height forward
motion_formulas.leg_raise: Left native thigh +55 degree and shin -20 degree smooth hold/release
motion_formulas.squat: Both thighs +50, shins -85, feet +15 degrees; root -0.085*height; not planted feet
motion_formulas.abrupt_stop: +Y .32*height travel stops by 55 percent; leg swing smoothly ends by that point

registered_body_status.definition: Actual evaluated registered Body, with Dress samples in native pelvis-to-knee projection interval
